:::: {layout="[ 60, 40 ]"}

::: {#first-column}
Hello! I am an Associate Professor of Computer Science at Grinnell College, as well as the Luebke-Sproehnle Endowed Chair in Computer Science. I do research in Network Science, with particular interests in models and higher-order interactions. I also teach undergraduate courses in intro programming and theoretical computer science. I am especially interested in developing computer science students to understand societal implications of technology through coursework.  
\
My research has previously been funded by the NSF and the Research Corporation for Science Advancement. I earned a PhD in mathematics from Purdue University.
